protocol.treatment: persistent guest/host 100ms + boundary PSS + two declared-file analyses at restore/continuation
protocol.shared_condition: same persistent runner, frozen actions, source checks, official tests, resource settings and image input
protocol.cache_policy: fresh private VM; host cache preserved; no global drop
protocol.retention: raw, hashes, results retained; successful private images removed; failures archived
protocol.stop_policy: first failure; first pair must pass before remaining four pairs; no retry
protocol.performance_scope: combined collection impact, not pure periodic-sampler overhead; inventory/cleanup in full_run
